title: La cordillera Blanca y los glaciares andinos
goal: Explore the high-altitude geography of the Cordillera Blanca, the Huascarán peak, and tropical glacial hydrology.
grammar: geomorfología de la cordillera Blanca, glaciología tropical e hidrología del río Santa

items: Analyze the physical geography of Huascarán, Alpamayo, and the Callejón de Huaylas.
Examine the vital dry-season role of glacial runoff for coastal and highland irrigation.
Deploy glacial, mountainous, and avalanche risk vocabulary (glaciar, aluvión, quebrada, morrena).
